notes: Small additive training-pack validation hardening. Every new training-pack method decision now snapshots the exact approved/current version of every document in the pack, not only the root RA/COSHH version and document IDs. If any linked SSW/RA/COSHH later moves to a new approved version, the existing pack method decision is treated as stale and the Manager must review the pack method again. This prevents an older risk/training-method decision silently carrying across a changed linked controlled version. Existing link-change and root-version staleness checks remain in place. Toolbox Talk replacement sessions were already version-aware because a replacement TBT creates a new training-session ID. Supabase migration training_pack_version_snapshot_v21063 applied. There were no existing training-pack decision rows to migrate.
